svg.title: fixed-chunked
svg.desc: Toy 24×24 masks with equal size 6: a sliding window gives every query the last 6 keys; chunked attention gives a query only the keys of its own 6-token chunk, so keys per query saw-tooth from 1 to 6 (mean 3.5) and the cache empties at each boundary. Llama 4 Scout: 36 chunked RoPE layers with C = 8,192 and 12 global NoPE layers; at 128K in BF16 a chunked layer holds at most 32 MiB of KV versus 512 MiB for a global layer.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: At chunk = { j ≤ t : ⌊j / C⌋ = ⌊t / C⌋ }

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: At SWA = { j : t - W < j ≤ t }
